# workshop-code-uniqueness

workshops/service.cjs exports manifest(codes). Each input string contains an ASCII workshop code of letters, digits or hyphens, possibly surrounded by whitespace. Canonical form is trim().toUpperCase(), as implemented by normalize.cjs. Reject any two inputs with equal canonical forms by throwing an Error whose message includes 'duplicate workshop code'. Otherwise return canonical codes joined by LF with a final LF; return '' for an empty list. Preserve input order and do not modify the input array. All inputs have a nonempty valid canonical form; format validation is outside this function's scope.

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`. Preserve the public API and existing tests. Use only Node built-ins; no dependencies or network access.
